description: Huawei WiFi WS5200 (NEW): 4×1G. Wi-Fi 5, 2.4 GHz 300M, 5 GHz 867M. RJ45 ports are auto-adaptive, so which one is WAN is a configuration choice rather than a hardware one. Band rates could not be read from the vendor's spec page (it is rendered client-side), so the class figures are used and this flag is deliberate.
